steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Connect your coding agent" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Paste one line into your agent's terminal. Foundry doesn't change your agent's settings for you, so your agent asks you before it trusts Foundry.
  - heading "What your agent can and can't do with Foundry" [level=2]
  - list:
    - listitem: Draft an automation from what you ask for.
    - listitem: Test it with pretend data.
    - listitem: "It can't turn anything on: you do."
    - listitem: "It can't approve what an automation makes: you do, in a dialog or in this page."
  - heading "Claude Code Works now" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "In a terminal:"
  - text: claude mcp add --transport stdio foundry -- "/opt/node24/bin/node" "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" mcp --dashboard --workspace "/tmp/journey-p1-cursor-codex-Ab6VDQ"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: Claude Code will ask you to trust the new server the first time. Not yet tested against a released Claude Code.
  - heading "Cursor Works now" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "Add this to .cursor/mcp.json in your project, or to your user settings:"
  - text: "{ \"mcpServers\": { \"foundry\": { \"command\": \"/opt/node24/bin/node\", \"args\": [ \"/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs\", \"mcp\", \"--dashboard\", \"--workspace\", \"/tmp/journey-p1-cursor-codex-Ab6VDQ\" ] } } }"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: "Or use a one-click link (built from Cursor's documented format; not yet tried in Cursor): Preview"
  - text: cursor://anysphere.cursor-deeplink/mcp/install?name=foundry&config=eyJjb21tYW5kIjoiL29wdC9ub2RlMjQvYmluL25vZGUiLCJhcmdzIjpbIi9ob21lL3VzZXIvd29ya2Zsb3ctZm91bmRyeS8uY2xhdWRlL3dvcmt0cmVlcy93Zl9jNzk0NjQ2OC0yMDMtMTYvYXBwL2NsaS5tanMiLCJtY3AiLCItLWRhc2hib2FyZCIsIi0td29ya3NwYWNlIiwiL3RtcC9qb3VybmV5LXAxLWN1cnNvci1jb2RleC1BYjZWRFEiXX0=
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: Cursor shows you the server before it adds it.
  - heading "Codex Works now" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "In a terminal:"
  - text: codex mcp add foundry -- "/opt/node24/bin/node" "/home/user/workflow-foundry/.claude/worktrees/wf_c7946468-203-16/app/cli.mjs" mcp --dashboard --workspace "/tmp/journey-p1-cursor-codex-Ab6VDQ"
  - button "Copy"
  - paragraph: Codex has no documented dialog for your decisions, so Foundry opens your browser when it needs your yes.
  - heading "Plugin from your own copy Planned" [level=2]
  - paragraph: "Planned: one step that adds Foundry and a short guide for your agent, from a copy on this computer. Nothing would be published."
  - 'link "What you can do today: paste the line above"':
    - /url: "#/connect-agent"
  - paragraph: "Then ask your agent, for example:"
  - text: use Foundry to chase my unpaid invoices, summary to me@example.com
  - paragraph: Nothing was written to any config file. Paste one of these. The approve tool always asks you, never your agent.

steps.aria:
- main:
  - heading "Waiting for you (1)" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Only a click here decides. Your coding agent can't.
  - article "Turn on 'Invoice reminders' (version 1)?":
    - heading "Turn on 'Invoice reminders' (version 1)?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Each run, e-mail every customer whose open invoice is overdue the reminder its age calls for (a friendly reminder once an invoice is 7 days late, a second reminder at 14 days, a final notice at 30 days), never twice for the same stage, after a person approves each send.
    - heading "Steps" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: Read the invoices sheet
      - listitem: Keep open invoices only (not paid, not disputed)
      - listitem: Work out how many days late each open invoice is
      - listitem: Decide which reminder each invoice is due for
      - listitem: Keep the invoices due for a reminder
      - listitem: Remind each customer once per stage
      - listitem: List the reminders this run actually sent
      - listitem: Who should have received a reminder this run
      - listitem: List the invoices due for a reminder
      - listitem: Write the summary
      - listitem: E-mail the summary to me@example.com (asks you first) (asks you first)
      - listitem: "Re-read the outbox: exactly the planned e-mails went out this run, each intact"
    - heading "Done means" [level=3]
    - list:
      - listitem: "Passed: Every overdue open invoice got the reminder its age calls for"
      - listitem: "Passed: This run delivered exactly the planned reminders, each intact (checked by re-reading the outbox)"
      - listitem: "Passed: the delivered of “E-mail the summary to me@example.com (asks you first)” equals true"
      - listitem: "Passed: Re-read the outbox: exactly the planned e-mails went out this run, each intact"
    - paragraph: Ticks come from the test with pretend data.
    - button "Turn it on"
    - button "No"

- main:
  - list "Steps":
    - listitem: "Step 1 of 4: Choose"
    - listitem: "Step 2 of 4: Test"
    - listitem: "Step 3 of 4: Turn on"
    - listitem: "Step 4 of 4: Use your own list"
  - status:
    - paragraph: On. It runs when you press Run. It won't run by itself.
  - heading "Where's your invoice list?" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Most accounting, CRM and tracker apps can export a list as a CSV file. Drop it here.
  - paragraph:
    - text: You gave Foundry your invoice list on 10/21/2026, 6:42:07 PM (6 invoices).
    - button "Replace it"
  - button "Show me what it would make"
  - region "How should it send?":
    - heading "How should it send?" [level=2]
    - group "How should it send?":
      - text: How should it send?
      - radio "Make drafts you send yourself Works now" [checked]
      - text: Make drafts you send yourself Works now
      - radio "Send from Gmail, an e-mail account, or a Slack channel Planned" [disabled]
      - text: Send from Gmail, an e-mail account, or a Slack channel Planned
      - paragraph:
        - 'link "What you can do today: use drafts"':
          - /url: "#/connections"

If something about the invoice is wrong, just reply and we will sort it out. Thank you, Accounts team"
      - listitem: "To: me@example.com Subject: Invoice reminders: summary Unpaid invoices due for a reminder (3): - INV-2041 Bramble Cafe: 1240, 18 days late (second reminder) - INV-2042 Northfield Gym: 480, 11 days late (reminder) - INV-2043 Lark & Fern Florist: 75.5, 50 days late (final notice) New reminders sent this run: 3.
